plain: E. Howard Hunt, a former officer of the CIA, America's foreign spy agency, is said to have claimed that President John F. Kennedy was killed in 1963 at least partly because of his questions about UFOs. Michels has told this several times, passing on what others say Hunt said: in some tellings the claim comes through Hunt's son, Saint John Hunt, and in others through a man named Douglas Caddy, who says he kept asking Hunt what the killing was really about until Hunt, near the end of his life, answered "the alien presence." The versions differ on whether UFOs were part of the reason or the whole of it, but if true, a president's death would be tied to the UFO secret.
